title: Talking-to-camera review
prompt_en: Vertical 9:16 medium close-up. A man in a hoodie sits in his car, looks into the phone camera and talks with expressive eyebrows, occasionally gesturing with one hand. Daylight through windshield, casual and honest tone.
prompt_zh: 竖屏 9:16 中近景。穿连帽衫的男人坐在车里，看着手机镜头说话，眉毛表情丰富，偶尔用一只手比划。日光透过挡风玻璃，随意真诚的语气。
why_it_works: Car-selfie is a high-recognition UGC setting; describing gestures instead of exact speech avoids lip-sync promises.
